faq.title: Viggle AI Alternative FAQ
faq.description: Common questions from Viggle users switching to our platform

items.question: Is the quality as good as Viggle?
items.answer: We use similar AI models (Kling AI, Wan 2.1) for motion transfer. For standard dance videos, quality is comparable. Viggle's proprietary JST-1 model may have slight advantages in complex physics scenarios, but for viral dance content, you won't notice a difference.

items.question: Why doesn't this require Discord?
items.answer: We built a proper web application with a dedicated API infrastructure. Viggle started as a Discord community project and grew from there. Different approaches - we prioritized user experience over community features.

items.question: Is it really free to try?
items.answer: Yes. New users get free credits to test the platform. No credit card required to start. If you like it, you can purchase more credits or subscribe.

items.question: Can I use my own reference videos like Viggle?
items.answer: Currently we focus on pre-made templates for the fastest, easiest experience. Custom video upload is on our roadmap for Pro users who want Viggle-style flexibility.

items.question: What if Viggle has a dance I want that you don't?
items.answer: Request it! We add new templates weekly based on user requests and trending content. Most popular requests are added within days.

items.question: Do I need to learn any commands?
items.answer: Zero commands. The entire flow is: click template → upload photo → click generate → download. That's it. No /mix, no parameters, no syntax to learn.
